messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Synthetic canary 'canary-eu-core' failed 5/5 pings over 2m. Check: /api/v1/health?canary=eu. Severity: P2. Pager: PagerDuty (PGL-CANARY-EU).

PagerDuty: page fired to @Sam L (primary oncall). Trigger ID: PD12345678. Escalation policy: Canary Checks EU.

Sam L: ack. I'm on it — pulling up synthetic dashboard, traces, and recent deploys.

Maya R: fyi there was a small canary deploy at 03:12 UTC to canary-runner-eu, build c7f2a. Might be related.

Sam L: running a quick curl from us-east to verify.
```bash
curl -v "https://internal-canary-eu.redwood.local/api/v1/health?canary=eu"
* Rebuilt URL to: https://internal-canary-eu.redwood.local/api/v1/health?canary=eu
* Connected to internal-canary-eu.redwood.local (10.3.5.12) port 443 (#0)
> GET /api/v1/health?canary=eu HTTP/1.1
> Host: internal-canary-eu.redwood.local
> User-Agent: curl/7.79.1
> Accept: */*
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
< content-length: 87
{
  "status": "unhealthy",
  "reason": "upstream 502"
}
```

Jordan T: metrics look bad — 502 spike and 5xx rate jumped ~15% starting 03:10 UTC. Canary latency up ~200ms.

Sam L: added APM annotation and started debug logs on canary-runner-eu. To reduce noise, initiating manual failover of canary traffic to eu-fallback pool now.

Maya R: please disable synthetic probes after failover so we stop paging while we investigate.

Incident Bot: action taken: synthetic-check disabled for 'canary-eu-core' by Maya R. Reason: mitigation while we root cause.

Sam L: after failover, health endpoint returns 200 from eu-fallback. Quick verification: 10 sequential curls -> all 200. Planning to scale down the affected canary-runner instances to grab core logs and sidecar traces.

Jordan T: logs show repeated TLS errors coming from the local sidecar: "tls: handshake failure: connection reset by peer" to upstream 10.3.4.8:443. Pattern started after build c7f2a.

Maya R: opening infra ticket and pinging infra rotation — possible sidecar TLS regression. Also creating PD incident INC-7764.

PagerDuty: acknowledged by Sam L. Escalation timer paused.

Sam L: Handoff note for next oncall: disabled synthetic probes, failed over canary -> eu-fallback, collecting sidecar logs + traces. Suspect regression in sidecar TLS in c7f2a. Staying on thread until Maya takes over for 04:00 UTC shift. :white_check_mark:

Maya R: taking over. I'll coordinate with infra and ops to rollback the sidecar change and will update every 10m. @PagerDuty please set incident status to "monitoring" and notify customers if SLA thresholds are crossed.

Jordan T: attaching logs bundle: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1764200000/canary-eu-logs.tar.gz and runbook ref: /runbooks/synthetic-canary-failures.

Sam L: quick customer impact assessment: no production traffic affected, canary-only. Risk: alert fatigue and missed real issues if this isn't suppressed quickly. Duration so far: 03:10 -> ongoing.

Maya R: update 03:38 UTC — infra confirmed sidecar TLS rollback in progress on canary-runner-eu nodes. Will run smoke tests after rollback and re-enable synthetic probes only after stable. Next update in 10m.

Sam L: thanks — leaving notes in the incident tracker. If rollback fails, we'll revert the canary deploy (c7f2a) and keep canary traffic on fallback until resolved.

Maya R: copy. Switching thread to monitoring; will ping if we need an escalation. :eyes:
